# Giving Compass

> > Giving Compass is a philanthropic intelligence platform that empowers donors, nonprofits, and businesses to make data-driven giving decisions and maximize charitable impact.

Giving Compass operates a comprehensive ecosystem connecting individual donors, nonprofit organizations, and institutional partners through research tools, nonprofit data, and impact analytics. The platform offers tiered access including free resources and Giving Compass Pro, a premium subscription service for advanced nonprofit research and donor insights.

## Core Platform

- [Giving Compass Site – Give with greater impact](https://givingcompass.org): Homepage for Giving Compass, a philanthropic platform enabling donors to give with greater impact.
- [Giving Compass Pro – Giving Compass Site](https://givingcompass.org/pro): Giving Compass Pro subscription product page with nonprofit research and impact analysis tools.
- [Research and Insights – Giving Compass Site](https://givingcompass.org/research-and-insights): Research and insights hub covering donor behavior, philanthropy trends, and data-driven giving.

## Solutions for Organizations

- [For Nonprofits – Giving Compass Site](https://givingcompass.org/for-nonprofits): Nonprofit resources page with donor discovery, profile management, and visibility tools.
- [For Businesses – Giving Compass Site](https://givingcompass.org/for-businesses): Business solutions page featuring Giving Compass API for nonprofit data and donor platform integration.

## Organization Information

- [About – Giving Compass Site](https://givingcompass.org/about): About page detailing Giving Compass mission, team leadership, and organizational values.
- [Giving Compass Blog - Giving Compass](https://givingcompass.org/blog): Blog hub featuring donor education, philanthropy insights, and giving trends.
- [Support our Work – Giving Compass Site](https://givingcompass.org/support-our-work): Donation page for Giving Compass Network with multiple giving methods and charitable options.

## Support and Contact

- [Contact Us – Giving Compass Site](https://givingcompass.org/contact-us): Contact page for donor relations, nonprofit partnerships, and technical support inquiries.

## Legal and Compliance

- [Financial Reports and Policies – Giving Compass Site](https://givingcompass.org/financial-reports-and-policies): Financial transparency page with IRS Form 990, annual reports, and accountability documentation.
- [Privacy Policy – Giving Compass Site](https://givingcompass.org/privacy-policy): Privacy policy covering data protection and user consent for Giving Compass platform.
- [User Agreement – Giving Compass Site](https://givingcompass.org/terms): User agreement and terms of service for Giving Compass platform membership.
